text:
<subject>Re: Lumière Santé Cover Letter & Resume for Édouard Guillaume</subject>
<body>
Thibaut, thanks for your quick reply. I’ve shared your note with Sébastien.

Also, thank you for the wonderful dinner and insightful meetings last week. I really appreciated learning more about Lumière Santé and was impressed by everyone I met.

Looking forward to collaborating with you over the next few months!!

Cheers,  
Thibaut
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr
Sent: Wednesday, 15 January 2025 14:39
To: thibaut.pons@lumieresante.fr
Cc: aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr
Subject: Re: Lumière Santé Cover Letter & Resume for Édouard Guillaume

Thibaut,

I have forwarded the resume to our Clinical Operations pool with  
a recommendation to accept Sébastien as a summer intern.

I expressed interest in having him join my team. He may, of course, choose a different department within Lumière Santé. It’s his decision, and I won’t be offended if he prefers to work in procurement or patient services.

Thibaut
</quoted>
